svg.title: All 32 city layouts from the city sheet at $9400
svg.desc: Thirty-two small maps, one per city, showing every structure in the game's own three-byte city records, coloured by category.
svg.text: The 32 cities, drawn from the game's own table
Every mark is one of 1,005 three-byte records in the sheet at $9400; x runs east, y north.
